entries.subject: Update Psalm to 7.0
entries.notes: sync 6f240a8f64: Psalm 7 and its CI workflow (dev tooling, no PHP runtime dependency changed but symfony/polyfill-mbstring 1.43.0->1.43.3 and symfony/filesystem 7.4.18->7.4.21 patch releases, which feed none of our fixtures; the reference keeps its installed vendor). The one code line, Privileges::getUsersOverview initialising $groupAssignment before the configurable-menus check, avoids an undefined PHP variable when user groups are off: our users overview builds the user group column from the user groups query result and shows no column without the feature.

entries.subject: Reset Routing::$route for token mismatch as well
entries.notes: sync 6f240a8f64: Follow-up to 910322373f (not-applicable): on a token mismatch phpMyAdmin also resets the static Routing::$route to "/". We keep no global route: a request without a valid CSRF header is refused before any route runs.

entries.subject: Fix #20525 - Undefined global variable $maxsize
entries.notes: sync 6f240a8f64: QA_5_2 fix merged into master: Export::exportDatabase reads $maxsize ?? ''. Our export already takes a missing maxsize parameter as the empty string (packages/export/src/export.ts), so every table is exported whatever its size.
